MessageToString: convert a protobuf message object to a human-readable text format string with optional formatting flags
Parse: parse a text-format protobuf string into an existing protobuf message object and merge the fields
Merge: merge a text-format protobuf string into a message allowing last-value-wins for non-repeated fields
PrintMessage: print a protobuf message to a file-like output object with configurable indentation and formatting options
MessageToBytes: convert a protobuf message to encoded text format bytes using ascii or utf-8 encoding
